common.footer: You receive this email because you use {product}.
common.security_footer: This is a security email about your {product} account: it is sent even if you turned off other emails.
common.ignore: If you did not expect this email you can ignore it.
common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

magic_link.subject: Your {product} sign-in link
magic_link.intro: Use this link to sign in. It expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
magic_link.hint: If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email: nobody can enter without the link.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirm.intro: Someone asked to use this address for a {product} account. Confirm to complete the change: the link expires in {hours} hours.
email_change_confirm.hint: If it was not you, ignore this email: the account keeps its current address.

email_change_notice.subject: Your {product} email address is changing
email_change_notice.intro: A change of the sign-in address of your account to {email} was requested. Nothing changes until the new address confirms.
email_change_notice.hint: If it was not you, sign in and change your password, then cancel the request from your profile.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {tenant} on {product}
invite.hint: Sign in with this email address: we will send you a link, no password needed.

mention.subject: {author} mentioned you on {record}
mention.intro: {author} mentioned you in a note on {record}:

supplier_po.subject: Purchase order {po} from {company}
supplier_po.intro: Hello {supplier}, {company} sent you purchase order {po}. Please confirm it or tell us about any problem from the page below.
supplier_po.hint: The link is personal to this order.

digest.subject: Your daily summary for {tenant}
digest.preheader: What you have not read in the last 24 hours.

test.subject: {product} test email
test.intro: This is a test email sent from the {product} console. If you are reading it, the sender, the domain and the provider work.

system.stock_critical_no_po: {title} selling variants at critical stock with nothing on order
system.export_ready: Your CSV export is ready: {title} rows ({body})
